_about: Real-format bounce and deferral texts for engine/deliverability/bounces.py, written from each provider's published error documentation (October 2026). Texts are the documented wording, cut where the documentation was read; IP addresses are TEST-NET (RFC 5737) and domains are example.com. 'source' names where the wording comes from; 'secondary' marks wording quoted by a third party rather than the provider. Run: python3 engine/deliverability/bounces.py --corpus examples/deliverability/bounces/corpus.json
